direction:
Brightside Dental is a family dental clinic in a mid-sized city.

Services: checkups, cleaning, fillings, root canal treatment, braces and children's dentistry.

Audience: mostly working adults aged 25 to 45 and parents of young children.

Customers' core problems: many put off visits because they are afraid it will hurt and they believe treatment is very expensive. Some think a root canal means losing the tooth.

How the business helps: comfort steps for patients who are afraid, and clear pricing for patients worried about cost.

Common questions patients ask about most: pain, cost, and whether treatment is needed.

Objections and misunderstandings: fear it will hurt, belief treatment is very expensive, belief that root canal means losing the tooth.

Tone: calm, friendly, honest.

Video plan: usual length 60 seconds. Mostly teach and reassure, mention services lightly.

Viewer next step: book a checkup.

On camera: a dentist from the clinic.

Owner insists on: avoid close-up treatment scenes.
